problem.title: DiLO KITTI Odom seq 00 full: comparison with the paper's KITTI table
problem.question: How close is the DiLO reimplementation to the paper's per-sequence KITTI Odometry translational error (official RTE)?

variants.label: DiLO, default parameters
variants.intent: Profile used for the repository's KITTI full-sequence runs (see the method README).
variants.note: DiLO: direct frame-to-keyframe LiDAR odometry via spherical-range-image projective data association (no NN search) + point-to-plane GN; constant-velocity prior, no GT seed. lookup_radius=1 lookup_max_dist=1.50 keyframes=1589
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.
